statement: A window of the BOEM northern Gulf deepwater bathymetry grid (west), forked to a derived dataset. Steps p1-p6 are BOEM's processing as reported on the product page and in Kramer and Shedd 2017; they carry no code.

source.description: Declared start: BOEM's library of time-migrated 3D seismic surveys (confidential).

processStep.description: Reported: seafloor horizon picked on 200+ surveys; where surveys overlap, the best resolution kept, leaving 117. Confidential data.
Reported: resampled to 40 x 40 ft cells, north-south, NAD27; small gaps filled by convergent gridding.
Reported: seams shifted by hand, +/-10-20 ms two-way time (seasonal Loop Current velocities). Manual.
Reported: two-way time in ms x 0.0005 to one-way seconds, then the 7th-order time-to-depth polynomial; depth in ft.
Reported: remaining gaps spliced in from 3D depth surveys.

report.name: outcome
report.description: Checked against 300 wells: mean error 1.3 % of water depth (product page).

processStep.description: Reported: exported from ArcMap as GeoTIFF; downloaded from the BOEM product page.
Fork: the window written as a derived dataset.
